topic.title: Gold price outlook: MCX gold slips for the week as US Fed rate hike bets rise; what’s next for the yellow metal?
topic.source_snippet: MCX gold prices declined, losing  ₹3,351 per 10 grams as traders reacted to higher US Treasury yields and Fed signals. September's gains turned into losses due to concerns over inflation and interest rate hikes, with October delivery gold closing at  ₹1,51,000.

news_analysis.headline_hook: Fed rate hike-ala unga 10g gold investment-la ₹2,500 loss! Unga pocket-ah check pannunga.
news_analysis.breaking_event_summary: MCX gold prices for October delivery fell to ₹1,51,000 per 10 grams, marking a weekly decline of ₹3,351 as market sentiment shifted due to rising US Treasury yields.
news_analysis.retail_illusion: Retail investors believe the drop is a direct, logical reaction to Fed rate hike fears, assuming that gold is now 'cheap' and a prime buying opportunity because the 'inflation hedge' has been temporarily discounted.
news_analysis.institutional_reality: Institutions are utilizing the 'Fed narrative' as a liquidity exit strategy. The price drop is driven by algorithmic rebalancing triggered by US Treasury yield spikes, which forces systematic funds to deleverage gold positions to maintain risk-parity models, regardless of gold's intrinsic value.
news_analysis.actionable_retail_rule: Never buy the 'dip' on gold during a Treasury yield spike until the 14-day RSI confirms a structural support level; wait for the institutional deleveraging cycle to exhaust its volume.

slides.title: Fed rate hike-ala unga Gold investment-la loss!

comparison_data.myth: Gold price drop aagum bodhu, idhu oru 'cheap buying opportunity' nu retail investors nambuvanga.
comparison_data.reality: Institutions idhai oru 'liquidity exit strategy'-ah use panni, algorithmic rebalancing moolama profit edupanga.

stat_data.label: Retail portfolio erosion
stat_data.context: US Treasury yields spike aagum bodhu, systematic funds gold-la irundhu veliyeeruvanga. Idhunaala ₹3,351 per 10g varai price drop aagi, retail investors-oda capital-ah silent-ah erode pannudhu.

slides.title: Institutional Liquidity Mechanism
slides.card_text: 1. US Fed signals-ah trigger-ah vachu algorithms sell order-ah execute pannum. 2. Treasury yields yerum bodhu, risk-parity models gold-ah deleverage pannum. 3. Retail investors 'dip' nu nambi buy pannum bodhu, institutions avanga liquidity-ah exit-ku use pannuvanga.

slides.title: Capital Extraction Logic
slides.card_text: Retail investors gold-ah inflation hedge-nu nambi hold pannuvanga. Aana, institutional algorithms gold-oda intrinsic value-ah vida, Treasury yield correlation-ah mukkiyama paarkum. Indha gap-la dhan unga capital silent-ah extract aagudhu.

slides.title: The Golden Institutional Rule
slides.card_text: Treasury yields spike aagum bodhu, 'buy the dip' nu kooda ninaikadheenga. 14-day RSI structural support-ah confirm pannum varai wait pannunga. Institutional deleveraging cycle volume exhaust aagum varai entry edukkaadheenga.
